_how_to_add: Signed artists page (zwrld.org/artists/). To add an artist, copy the block in _template into the artists list below and fill it in. name, photo, bio and genre are needed; hometown and every link are optional (leave "" to hide). photo is a file in src/assets/ (e.g. assets/artists/phil.jpg) or a full https:// image link. Artists show in the order listed. An empty list shows "New artists coming soon".
headline: Signed artists
intro: The artists signed to ZWrld Music.

artists.name: ZWrld
artists.bio: ZWrld (Zach Ikenberry) is a singer-songwriter from Diagonal, Iowa, writing country songs about faith, loss, and the people who shaped him. He started out in hip-hop, releasing his debut project "Start of a New Life" in 2020.
